categories.label: Competitiveness
categories.description: How close it was: final margin plus the share of the game played within one score (8 points).

categories.label: Drama
categories.description: Lead changes and ties (especially in the last five minutes or overtime), the biggest deficit the winner overcame, and CFBD's win-probability excitement index (2014+).

categories.label: Finish
categories.description: How late it was decided: overtime, go-ahead or tying scores in the final minutes, walk-off endings. A game-winning touchdown counts more than a game-winning field goal.

categories.label: Stakes
categories.description: What was on the line: rankings of both teams, rivalries, conference title games, bowls and the playoff.

categories.label: Upset
categories.description: How unlikely the winner was before kickoff, from the betting spread (2013+) or Elo ratings.

categories.label: Fireworks
categories.description: Combined scoring, with a bump when both teams put up 35+.

categories.label: Star Power
categories.description: Talent on the field: NFL draft picks on both teams (1st-rounders count most), national stat leaders, and hand-picked stars like Heisman winners. Best when both teams are loaded.

categories.label: Star Performance
categories.description: The best individual stat line in the game, weighted by the setting: title games, playoff games and ranked opponents count more, as does winning.
